name: @rdplatforms/static-data
description: Temporary static JSON data source. Business-content collections (businesses/services/gallery/etc.) are consumed only through @rdplatforms/services, never imported directly from UI code — see docs/future-backend-contract.md. Other, non-business collections (e.g. cards/, for apps/rtsh-info) are outside that domain and may have their own dedicated registry in the consuming app instead.
